💿〖 Strawberry Ade & Bookmark 〗Album Released!  
 
Hello, my BDD Journalers!  
 
Thanks to the wonderful and overwhelming requests from so many of you, I'm so excited to announce that 'Strawberry Ade & Bookmark (11 Tracks)' playlist has officially been released as a regular album! 🎉 
You can stream and listen to it right now on YouTube Music, Spotify, Apple Music, and more. 🎧 
If there are any other playlists you'd love to hear as an official album next, let me know in the comments below! Thank you always. ✨ 
 
------------------------------------------- 
 
안녕하세요, BlueDot Diary입니다. :) 
 
감사하게도 많은 분들께서 꾸준히 요청해 주셨던 덕분에, 채널에서 큰 사랑을 받았던 'Strawberry Ade & Bookmark (11 Tracks)' 플레이리스트가 드디어 정식 음원 앨범으로 발매되었습니다! 🎉 
 
여러분의 소중한 응원 덕분에 이렇게 선물 같은 소식을 전할 수 있게 되었어요. 
지금 바로 유튜브 뮤직, 스포티파이, 애플뮤직, 등에서 만나보실 수 있습니다. 🎧 
 
다음 앨범으로 꼭 듣고 싶은 최애 플리가 있다면 댓글로 미리 찜해 주세요!  
많은 관심과 사랑에 보답할게요! 감사합니다. ✨
Let this gentle rhythm be a reminder that it is okay to rest and take things one step at a time, you are doing great and the universe is proud of you 🌻

Needed this reminder more than you know today..🥺 
Thank you for sharing such beautiful words-it really anchored my heart. 
Sending all that lovely energy right back to you! 🤍🌙
@BlueDotDiary 🥰

So glad these tunes can keep you company along the way! 🍓🤍✨

I’m so glad the algorithm led you to my channel! 🍓✨🤍
